question: Do H8 direction hit rate and realized H8 absolute cumulative log-return magnitude vary across pre-defined predicted-strength bins?

method.primary_forecast: Saved H8 mean log-return prediction from the same W16/core Ridge(alpha=1) outer fold model.
method.strength: abs(predicted H8 mean observed-transition log return); display cumulative expected log return magnitude as abs(8 * predicted mean * 10000) basis points (bp of log return, not pips).
method.train_strength: Reconstruct in-sample train predictions only from each saved H8 fold coefficient/intercept and x/y scaler; do not refit. Use existing H24-purged training origins and the saved W16/core feature matrix.
method.quantiles: Within each fold, calculate linearly interpolated 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles of absolute training H8 predictions. Apply the fold-specific edges unchanged to that fold outer-validation predictions.
method.right_closed_ties: Bins are (-inf,q20], (q20,q40], (q40,q60], (q60,q80], (q80,+inf); use searchsorted(edges, strength, side=left). A value equal to an edge stays in the lower bin. Repeated edges produce empty bins; do not merge or split tied values.
method.pooled_bins: ALL aggregates combine within-fold quintile bins using each fold own train-derived edges; they are rank-stratum summaries, not one common absolute-strength scale.
method.zero_rule: Exact-zero forecast is abstention; report separately. Exact-zero realized H8 target is counted and excluded from direction hit/balanced accuracy.
method.actual_magnitude: abs(8 * actual H8 mean log return * 10000), an absolute cumulative log-return magnitude in bp over eight observed transitions; report mean, median, and q25/q75.
method.baseline: Saved fold-specific train-majority H8 label from the prior run, evaluated on the same nonzero-realized subset; ties remain abstentions.
method.secondary_filter_bins: Reuse the same H8-strength bin assigned to each validation origin; no additional thresholds.
method.path_diagnostic: If locally saved raw OHLC for the permitted prefix exists, compute descriptive close-origin crossings in both directions and max high/low excursions across the next eight observed bars. Do not use as input, filter, or confidence. If not available, state blocker and omit.

per_fold_and_all_bins: balanced accuracy when both actual classes occur
secondary_filters: per-bin accepted count and coverage within H8-strength bin
H8 directional hit on accepted subset
reported_metrics.no_selection: Do not select or recommend a bin based on observed validation performance.

limitations: Historical development prefix and folds were previously examined; this is not independent confirmation.
Neighboring H8 outcomes overlap; no IID significance or profitability claim.
Bid/spread data are incomplete; no trading result is estimated.
path_data_availability: Initial local inventory found no raw EURUSD OHLC export in the saved horizon-agreement run; only derived feature matrix, targets, model parameters, splits, and predictions are present. No external retrieval is planned.
